title: The Fox and the Grapes
summary: A hungry man tries to reach some high food but cannot get it.
coverScene: A clever fox looks up with desire at a rich bunch of purple grapes hanging high on a green vine.

sentences.text: One day, a man walks.
He looks for food.
His body feels very bad.
He wants something good to eat.
Then he sees a tall plant.
A number of things stay high.
The food looks very good.
The man runs toward the plant.
He wants to get those things.
He moves up with all force.
He cannot reach the food.
His hand lets go of the plant.
He falls back down to land.
He sits on the floor.
He looks up at the food again.
The man does not give up.
He steps back and tries again.
He moves as high as possible.
The things remain too high up.
He still cannot get any thing.
The man stops moving and stands.
He feels bad now.
He uses so much force.
He looks up one last time.
He sees the result is not possible.
His body really feels bad now.
He stays right there for a minute.
The man turns away from the plant.
He walks down a long way.
He tells himself a little story.
He says the things are bad.
He thinks he never wants them.
He knows the food is not good.
He walks away into the day.
He looks for other food now.

sentences.text: One fine day, a certain animal walked through a field.
He looked for food because his body felt quite low.
Suddenly, he saw a beautiful group of fine food.
The food stayed high upon a green plant.
The good food made him really want to eat.
The animal ran toward the plant to get the food.
He tried to get up with all his power.
However, he could not reach the food.
His hand missed the plant completely.
Then he fell back down to the ground.
The animal did not give up yet.
He stepped back and tried again and again.
He tried as high as possible.
The food remained too high above him.
After many hard tries, he still could not get them.
Down and low, the animal stopped playing.
He stood upon the ground.
He felt completely done from his hard effort.
Looking up one last time, he realized success was out of reach.
His foot and body felt bad.
Quickly, the person turned away from the plant.
He began walking down the road.
He told himself a story to feel better.
He said that the food was probably very bad.
He thought he never wanted them anyway.
The day was long and hard.
He will go home now.
He will find other food to eat.
Every animal has bad days like this.
He will try again another time.

sentences.text: One fine day, a certain animal walked through a warm field looking for food.
His inner body felt quite empty, and he really wanted something good to eat.
Suddenly, he saw a beautiful collection of fine food hanging high on a green plant.
The fruit looked very sweet and full of water, which made him even more ready.
The animal ran toward the plant because he wanted to get those wonderful things.
He jumped up with all his power, but he could not reach the fruit.
If he had been tall, he might have touched them on the first try.
Instead, his feet missed the branch completely, and he fell back down to the ground.
Not giving up yet, the smart animal stepped back and tried again and again.
He jumped as high as possible, reaching out his front feet with every single effort.
However, the food remained too high above him, hanging safely out of his reach.
After many hard tries, he still could not get even one single piece.
Tired and angry, the animal stopped jumping and stood quietly on the ground.
He was completely tired out because he had spent so much energy.
He had spent that energy trying to win the award.
Looking up one last time at the high plant, he realized that success was impossible.
His tired legs hurt, and his breath came fast from the difficult exercise.
Slowly, the sad animal turned away from the plant and began walking down the road.
To make himself feel better about failing, he told himself a little story.
He spoke low that the food was probably very bad and not worth eating anyway.
The animal acted like he never wanted them.
He showed how people often hate what they cannot have.
He had lived in the country for many years and knew how things worked.
Every single morning, he went out to search for something nice.
Today was no different from any other time in his long life.
The sun shone brightly down upon the green fields and tall trees.
Birds flew high across the blue sky while the wind blew softly.
He walked past several houses and small shops on his way.
Nobody was outside on the street during those quiet hours.
The air felt warm and nice against his face as he moved forward.
He always hoped that today would bring him a wonderful meal.
Instead, he only found trouble and a high plant that troubled him.
He had already tried everything within his power to reach the top.
His heart beat fast against his body from all the hard jumping.
If he had longer legs, the story would have ended differently.
He might have walked away with a full body and a happy mind.
Now he only had empty feelings and sore feet to show for his work.
The afternoon sun began to drop low behind the far hills.
Dark shapes grew long across the land path where he stood alone.
He took one last look at the hanging food high above him.
The green leaves shook slightly in the calm evening wind.
He turned his back on the plant for good and started his journey home.
The long road stretched out before him in the light.
He promised himself that he would find food somewhere else tomorrow.
Life must go on even when things do not go the right way.
He walked slowly into the night until he was completely gone from sight.

sentences.text: One fine day, a certain animal walked through a warm field looking for food.
His stomach felt quite empty, and he really wanted something good to eat.
Suddenly, he saw a beautiful bunch of sweet fruit hanging high on a green plant.
The food looked very nice and full of water, which made him even more interested.
The animal ran toward the plant because he wanted to get those fine things.
He jumped up with all his power, but he could not reach the fruit.
If he had been taller, he might have touched them on the first try.
Instead, his hands missed the branch completely, and he fell back down to the ground.
Not giving up yet, the smart creature stepped back and tried again and again.
He jumped as high as possible, reaching out his front hands with every single effort.
However, the sweet fruit remained too high above him, hanging safely out of his reach.
After many hard tries, he still could not get even one single piece.
Tired and sad, the animal stopped jumping and stood quietly on the ground.
He was completely exhausted because he had spent so much energy trying to win the prize.
Looking up one last time at the high plant, he realized that success was impossible.
His tired legs hurt, and his breath came fast from the difficult exercise.
Slowly, the sad animal turned away from the plant and began walking down the road.
To make himself feel better about failing, he told himself a little story.
He said that the sweet fruit was probably very bad and not worth eating anyway.
The animal pretended he never wanted them, showing how people often look down on what they cannot have.
Many hours passed while he walked across the large field in the warm sun.
He thought about the wonderful plant and the sweet food hanging above his head.
It seemed very strange that such a fine prize could remain completely out of reach.
Perhaps another day might bring better luck if he returned to the same place.
However, the animal knew deep inside that success would require much more height.
His body felt weak from all the hard jumping and the long walk.
Therefore, he decided to continue his journey toward home without looking back.
The afternoon sun slowly moved across the blue sky as evening began to approach.
Small birds flew quietly between the trees while the wind blew gently through the grass.
Everything around the tired traveler became quiet and still as night started to fall.
He found a safe place to rest his tired body until the morning light returned.
Even though he had failed, the experience taught him something about human nature and desire.
People often pretend that things they cannot achieve are simply not worth having.
This smart trick of the mind helps individuals deal with trouble and failure.
Throughout history, stories like this one have been shared across many different cultures.
Children and adults together learn valuable lessons from the actions of animals in tales.
The animal in the story chose to protect his pride rather than accept his limitation.
By convincing himself that the sweet fruit was bad, he felt better about his loss.
Such behavior can be observed in everyday life when individuals miss important opportunities.
When a goal proves too difficult, people frequently invent excuses to hide their fear.
This psychological defense mechanism allows everyone to maintain a positive self-image despite problems.
The warm field remained empty as the stars slowly appeared in the night sky above.
No other creatures came to disturb the quiet place where the high plant grew.
The sweet fruit stayed safely on its branch through the long hours of darkness.
Morning would soon arrive with a new day and fresh challenges for all living things.
Until then, the world rested in deep silence under the bright light.
The tale of the animal and the high plant remains a famous example of human knowledge.
Children and adults learn valuable lessons from the actions of animals in tales.
